description: This is a Java class named LoanAccountLockHelper, which provides helper methods for placing soft locks on loan accounts within integration tests for the Fineract platform. It interacts with internal API endpoints related to loan account locking and utilizes RestAssured request and response specifications.

classes.name: LoanAccountLockHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing soft locks on loan accounts during integration testing.

methods.name: LoanAccountLockHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing request and response specifications for API interactions.

methods.name: placeSoftLockOnLoanAccount
methods.description: Places a soft lock on a loan account with given loanId and lockOwner; deprecated version without error parameter.

methods.name: placeSoftLockOnLoanAccount
methods.description: Places a soft lock on a loan account with optional error message, calling an internal API endpoint.
